name: Projected Interpolation Degree / VC Dimension
details: A largest shattered projection is a full cube.
proof: If $S$ is shattered with $|S|=d$, then $\mathcal H_{|S}=\{0,1\}^S$. The interpolation degree of this full $d$-cube is $d$, so the maximum over projections is at least $d=\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)$.
